title: Entity navigation context
responsibility: Builds related explorer locations while preserving branch and revision context.

inputs.name: entityLens.to
inputs.description: Optional target commit, category, entity, section and tab. Omitted commit/category retain the current values; null commit explicitly selects current mode.

outputs.name: entityLabels
outputs.description: Titles, singular labels and descriptions for the six explorer collections.

outputs.name: entityLens
outputs.description: Location retaining branch and revision; helper identity follows tabs and commits only within the same owning entity. Catalog and different-entity links discard it.

outputs.name: shortCommit
outputs.description: First seven characters of the supplied commit.

examples.name: Abbreviate a commit to its first seven characters
Preserve commit text shorter than seven characters

examples.subject: entityLens
examples.name: Moves to another category and entity without carrying tabs
examples.call: entityLens({branch: 'feature/orders', commit: 'bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb', category: 'pages', entity: 'app.page.orders', tab: 'tests'}, {category: 'components', entity: 'app.component.order-list'})

examples.subject: entityLens
examples.name: Keeps branch-tip mode when opening an entity section

examples.subject: entityLens
examples.name: Adds a source tab to an entity section
examples.call: entityLens({branch: 'feature/orders', commit: null, category: 'pages', entity: 'app.page.orders', section: 'details'}, {entity: 'app.page.orders', section: 'details', tab: 'source'})

examples.subject: entityLens
examples.name: Uses an explicitly selected commit
examples.call: entityLens({branch: 'feature/orders', commit: null, category: 'pages', entity: 'app.page.orders', section: 'history'}, {commit: 'aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa', entity: 'app.page.orders'})

examples.subject: entityLens
examples.name: Clears the entity when opening another collection
examples.call: entityLens({branch: 'feature/orders', commit: null, category: 'pages', entity: 'app.page.orders', section: 'history'}, {category: 'services'})

examples.subject: entityLens
examples.name: Overview removes a prior section
examples.call: entityLens({branch: 'feature/orders', commit: null, category: 'pages', entity: 'app.page.orders', section: 'history'}, {entity: 'app.page.orders'})

examples.subject: entityLens
examples.name: Keeps helper identity on its own history
examples.call: entityLens({branch: 'feature/orders', commit: 'bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb', category: 'functions', entity: 'app.function.filter-orders', helper: 'filterOrders'}, {entity: 'app.function.filter-orders', section: 'history', commit: 'aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa'})
